Download prototype 012.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004–011 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Areas beyond Viridian remain blocked. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Oak walks to collect the two visible Pokédexes before giving them out. The last starter ball has its own message. Viridian’s old man and his granddaughter block the center before the Pokédex. His lesson removes the temporary invisible barriers; she walks aside and starts wandering. The two outer paths have Cut trees that remain until you use Cut. A guard blocks the west exit before parcel delivery. Return afterward to the upper Mart cashier for your one-time Pokégear reward with the Town Map card and Kanto map enabled. Blue’s full portrait appears in the touch-screen panel during his introduction and name confirmation. Eevee and its sparkles share Marill’s original resting position. Start a new game to check the intro. Route 2 and Viridian Forest remain closed for the next prototype. Evolution supplies remain in the player’s PC. Use a new game or a save made before parcel delivery to see the revised Oak scene.
